producer_report.summary:
I added the second firstmate study, milestone M2 (long-running sessions), at the same pinned commit (6407052f…). It lives in studies/firstmate-long-running-sessions/ and has the same seven files, shape and 18 validation rules as the work-handling study.

- **Claims:** 47, each citing file lines at the pin with verbatim quotes. They cover session start and the lock, the digest's runtime bound, reconciliation after a restart, watcher continuity, away mode, the stale-worker timings, secondmate relaunch, self-update and drift, and compaction and the startup-memory allowance.
- **Model:** 9 states, 18 transitions with guards, 3 counters (relaunch-attempts, watcher-down-generation, startup-memory-tokens), unhandled failures, concurrency and 2 touchpoints.
- **Retries:** bounded retries carry their bounds: 5 re-arm retries, 3 relaunches per 3600 s. Retries with no bound found carry a claim saying so.
- **Rationale cards:** 8, of which 6 are stated with a quote.
- **Findings:** 7. They mark the failure edges as not run, because no run boundary was given. They also record the gaps where the source says nothing: crash cut-offs, context rot, away-mode alerts on non-macOS platforms and deadlines, and scheduled drift checks.
- **Intro:** intro.json is written for outside readers. A new test checks that every claim id it names exists.
- **Code:** in crates/athena-cap-study/src/rules.rs I added two tests that run all 18 rules against the pinned tree for the new study. They check that its validation.json matches the computed result and the first study's rule list, and that the claims are tagged. This code change goes beyond the planned deliverables.
- **Changelog:** CHANGELOG.md has an entry.
- **Old study:** nothing under studies/firstmate-work-handling/ changed.

open_issues: xtask/src/site.rs and the Pages workflow publish only studies/firstmate-work-handling. The new study is not on the published page, and site generation was out of scope for this job. A follow-up needs a generic generator or a second STUDY_DIR.
Every failure and retry edge (t3, t4, t7, t8, t14) is marked could-not-run, because no run boundary was given.
Crash survival rests on read claims only. The pinned text does not say what a crash does to a half-finished operation (finding f4).
The study found no measure of context rot beyond compaction and the startup-memory allowance (finding f5). It records this as a gap and does not invent a mechanism.
mistakes: I started a `tail` command, which the producer role does not allow. It was blocked, and I reran the command without it.
learnings: The kept tests in crates/athena-cap-study/src/rules.rs hard-coded the work-handling study directory and skip silently when pinned-source/ is absent. With `--nocapture` the skip message is printed, and it was absent in my runs.

StateKind has no 'session ended' success state. A retry edge is any failure edge whose target can reach its source again, so every failure edge in a restartable lifecycle needs a bound or a bound_absent claim.
A claim's quote only has to be a substring of the cited line range, so a range of one or two lines around the quote absorbs small line-number slips.
xtask/src/site.rs renders only the work-handling study (STUDY_DIR is a constant), so the new study is not published without a generator change.
The quote check joins the cited lines with newlines, so a quote must stay inside a single line or must reproduce the line breaks exactly.
desires: A way to run the studied system under a recorded boundary, so the failure and retry edges could be observed instead of marked could-not-run.
A generic site generator. xtask/src/site.rs has the study directory hard-coded, so the new study will not appear on the page without a change.
